name: problem-notes
description: Renders notes with a *** separator as tap-to-reveal problem/answer cards, and adds a one-tap AnkiDroid sync.

scripts.build: npm run test:contract && npm run test:render && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Problem Notes contributors
